title: The Iron Will
description: Steele has fielded every contract himself for fifteen years, since Hadrian Iron died with an arrow in his throat and left the Company to him. He's tired in a way he won't say out loud, and the Crossroads cost the Company men he can't easily replace. He wants someone he trusts running contracts while he handles the ledger and the clients - and the only way the Company knows to settle who that is, is a duel with the Captain himself.

objectives.description: Present yourself at the Iron Hall for the duel
Duel Steele himself, no formation to hide in this time
Accept the rank of Iron Lieutenant from Steele's own hand

notes: Threat: minimal by design - this is the line's capstone rite, matching wizard_final_trial and mage_13_council_seat's shape. Giver motive: Steele, worn down since the Crossroads, wants a second he trusts running contracts. Consequence: becoming Iron Lieutenant should free Steele to work contracts directly rather than always fielding them out - stated in prose only, no world_flags_to_set exists to record it and none was added since this is a terminal quest with no successor to read one.
